subject: Gate results for the context-window and multimodal-upscale arms

q38-context-window-v1.change: analyzer history budget 31,744 -> 48,128; vLLM --max-model-len 65,536 -> 81,920 so generation headroom stays 33,792

mechanism.basis: solution/analysis/history_hysteresis_replay.py over each arm's OWN 25 transcripts at its OWN budget

PASS but MARGINAL (431.2, a 19.2% drop against a 20% bar)
gate_conditions.shared: all 25 games ran: PASS, and all 25 held the full 7,920s slot
gate_conditions.shared: zero relaunch-to-stock: PASS. The string 'relaunching stock vLLM' appears in all three kernel logs at t=7-8s as the setup script's own SOURCE being echoed, not as an event; KV size 398,272 (not 199,136) confirms fp8 KV is live in every arm.

paired_sign_test_vs_control.note: For scale, the context-hysteresis arm's own paired test against the publisher's byte-identical control was p = 0.388. This is the first arm in the project with a paired result anywhere near significance.

q38-context-window-v1.why_this_is_believed: The outcome and the mechanism both moved, in the predicted direction, and the gain is DISTRIBUTED: 11 of 25 games gained and only 3 lost. It is not a single-game artefact. Notably ft09, the game the docs single out as swinging the 25-game mean by +/-1.0, LOST 2 levels, so the mean gain of +1.72 is achieved despite its biggest known confound moving against us.
honest_caveats: Generation throughput fell 19.2%, just inside the 20% bar. That is the expected cost of longer prompts and is the right trade given fp8 KV already showed +28.7% delivered tokens buys +0 levels, but a tighter bar would have failed it.

Live prefix-cache hit rate FELL, 62.2% to 56.7%, because each request is larger. The append-only rate (the replay proxy for cache stability) rose 71.3% to 81.9%. These disagree in sign and only the second is a mechanism measurement.

n = 1 commit. At the level-count noise of this instrument a byte-identical rerun has differed by 6 levels. +10 is outside that, and the paired test is the stronger evidence, but this is still one run.
This does NOT establish a hidden-set gain. Per-draw sigma on the board is 0.315.

q38-ctxwin-upscale16-v1.change: MULTIMODAL_UPSCALE 8 -> 16 on top of the context-window arm
q38-ctxwin-upscale16-v1.this_is_exactly_what_the_phantom_token_m: Upscale 16 raises the ESTIMATED image charge from 1,585 to 3,891 tokens (2.45x) against a true cost of 256 to 1,024, so it spends the raised context budget on phantom tokens and pushes retained history back down. The model put arm B at 5.9 retained turns against arm A's 8.3, essentially back to the shipped config's 5.5. The measured level count lands exactly on the control's 23. Outcome matches prediction.
q38-ctxwin-upscale16-v1.consequence: This is a rejection of upscale 16 AS SHIPPED TODAY, not of the visual-resolution hypothesis. Retest it only AFTER the image-token estimator fix, which drops the upscale-16 charge from 3,891 to 1,039.

what_this_does_not_settle: Whether the gain transfers to the hidden set. Per-draw board sigma is 0.315 and a byte-identical resubmission of our previous best scored 1.68 then 1.05. The 25-game commit can kill a lever or fail to kill it; the paired sign test at p=0.029 is the strongest promotion evidence this project has produced, and it is still one run.
